title: P/E Ratio Calculator
formula_verified: P/E Ratio = Market Price per Share / Earnings per Share (EPS). EPS = Net Profit / Outstanding Shares. Forward P/E uses projected EPS. PEG = P/E / Earnings Growth Rate. Low P/E relative to sector may indicate undervaluation.

what_is: A P/E Ratio Calculator is a digital tool that allows you to price-to-earnings ratio without complex manual calculations. In the Indian financial ecosystem, accurate calculations are crucial given dynamic tax slabs, RBI interest rate changes, SEBI regulations, and government scheme updates. how_to_use: Step 1: Open the P/E Ratio Calculator on this page. Step 2: Enter your Current Share Price (₹) (e.g., ₹500). Step 3: Enter your Earnings Per Share (₹) (e.g., ₹25). Step 4: Enter your Industry Average P/E (e.g., ₹20). Step 5: Enter your Earnings Growth Rate (%) (e.g., ₹15). Step 6: Click 'Calculate' to see instant results. Step 7: Review the detailed breakdown and use results for financial planning. Step 8: Adjust inputs to explore different scenarios.
